metadata.raw_content: AGOQ Workout 2 Complete as many rounds and reps as possible in 4, 8, 12, 16 or 20 minutes of: 25 toes-to-bars 50 double-unders 15 squat cleans* Begin with a 4 minute time cap. Etc., adding 4 minutes per round completed for up to 20 minutes. *1st round, 15 reps at 135 / 85 lb. 2nd round, 13 reps, 185 / 115 lb. 3rd round, 11 reps, 225 / 145 lb. 4th round, 9 reps, 275 / 175 lb. 5th round, 7 reps, 315 / 205 lb.
